name: telar
description: Telar — an agent cockpit: run many coding agents across projects from one desktop app, and watch them work.
author: Facundo Barbera <facundo.barbera@gmail.com>

scripts.verify: bun run check:source && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/engine-client typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/engine typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:engine-client && bun run test:env && bun run test:engine && bun run test:web && bun run test:desktop && bun run test:workers
scripts.//test:engine: THROUGH THE BOUNDED WRAPPER — #807. The engine suite is the one that produced 28-to-56-minute `bun test` processes with no output kept, so the run CI and `bun run test` perform is the one that tees to a timestamped log, kills the whole process group at a wall-clock budget, and reports `hung` rather than a non-zero nobody can tell from a red test. `bun run --cwd apps/engine test` is unchanged for a person running the suite by hand.
